By the River Swarming with Evil () is an upcoming South Korean television series directed by Park Yoo-young and starring Choi Hyun-wook. It tells the love story of a shaman who just wanted an ordinary life and love, and a man who's lived a hellish life.

Development
It was announced in November 2025 that director Park Yoo-young was preparing for the series.

In late 2025, Choi Hyun-wook had been cast.
